IncidentBot: :rotating_light: HIGH 5xx spike detected for inference-runtime (us-west-2) at 1715104444. Services: /v1/generate (text), /v1/chat. Error class: kv-decode-exception. Escalating to on-call Priya. PagerDuty PD-2874.
Priya Shah: I'm taking this. starting with quick health checks and deployment diff.
Sam Ortiz: saw reports from canary that errors started after a rolling deploy 1715104400 which included batching tweak + new 4-bit quant kernel. Logs show 'kv: decode failed: unexpected header' repeated.
Lucas Patel: On traces I'm seeing clients hitting cached prefixes that load older kv blobs -> decode-failure -> runtime returns 503. New kernel changed serialized ordering for small int arrays.
Irene Novak: That matches my local repro. If we don't handle version mismatch when deserializing, we throw. Runtime should accept older formats or at least fall back.
Priya Shah: Immediate mitigations: 1) disable new quant kernel on affected pool 2) add runtime try-catch to fall back to safe-deserialize (hotfix) 3) reduce batching window to avoid cross-request reuse 4) add temporary routing to non-quant model-variant for critical tenants. I'll patch routing and trigger kernel toggle.
Sam Ortiz: I'll flip the kernel flag in pool-runtime-us-west-2a/b. Running script:
```
# toggle quant kernel env and reload
sudo systemctl set-environment REDWOOD_USE_4BIT=0
sudo systemctl restart redwood-runtime
```
DeployBot: Rolling restart of 12 hosts in pool-runtime-us-west-2a initiated by Sam Ortiz at 1715104480.
Sam Ortiz: 2a restarted, health checks green, error rate down ~55% in that AZ. Proceeding to 2b.
Priya Shah: Patching safe-deserialize now (hotfix branch redwood/runtime/hotfix/kv-fallback). Will push with constrained rollout to canaries first.
Lucas Patel: Meanwhile I'm running a targeted purge of the offending KV prefix for model:stable-v3 to remove incompatible blobs. Command:
```
kv-admin --env=prod --region=us-west-2 purge --prefix=model:stable-v3:kvcache --batch-size=500 --dry-run=false
```
Lucas Patel: Purge started at 1715104575, progress 20% -> 70% -> 100% over ~8 minutes.
Irene Novak: Dropping batching window now to 16ms to reduce cross-request sharing. Will monitor throughput impact.
Nora (customer-ops): Notifying affected customers. I have a list: alpha-app, beta-chat (partial), gamma-analytics (minor). Preparing a brief with ETA for full restoration.
Priya Shah: After hotfix on canaries looks stable, we can roll the safe-deserialize to the rest. Hotfix passed canaries at 1715104688. Rolling at 1715104710.
DeployBot: Hotfix deployment to runtime pool completed at 1715104802.
Sam Ortiz: After full roll and purge, 5xxs dropped to baseline. Latency increased ~4% due to reduced batching but acceptable.
Priya Shah: Root cause summary (preliminary): new 4-bit quant kernel changed byte-order for small int arrays in KV serialization; runtime load path lacked format version check and crashed on unexpected header -> propagated as 503. Increased batching changed cache hit patterns, widening exposure.
Irene Novak: Repro steps and logs saved: //internal/infra/logs/kv-compat-171510.tar.gz. I added unit test case that simulates old kv blob + new kernel.
Priya Shah: Impact: peak error rate 18% across us-west-2 for ~12 minutes. Critical tenants: alpha-app saw ~10% of requests failing for 9 minutes. No secrets leaked.
Nora (customer-ops): Sent immediate note to alpha-app ops. They'll request a formal postmortem and remediation plan.
Priya Shah: Scheduling postmortem meeting: proposed 1715160000 (~48h). Attendees: Lucas, Sam, Irene, Nora, runtime product, security if needed. I'll create doc and agenda. Action items being created now:
- INFR-3201: Implement KV-format version header and strict compatibility layer (owner: Lucas Patel, due: 2024-06-14)
- INFR-3202: Add CI matrix test for quant kernel changes vs legacy kv blobs (owner: Irene Novak, due: 2024-06-10)
- INFR-3203: Add runtime defensive fallback for unknown kv headers with safe-deserialize + metric (owner: Priya Shah, due: 2024-06-09)
- INFR-3204: Add canary gating rule for combined kernel+batching deploys (owner: Sam Ortiz, due: 2024-06-08)
- INFR-3205: Console tool: one-click KV prefix purge with soft-ttl and impact estimation (owner: Lucas Patel, due: 2024-06-12)
- INFR-3206: Update runbook 'runtime-kv-incompat' with mitigation checklist and customer-ops playbook (owner: Nora (customer-ops), due: 2024-06-07)
Priya Shah: Also short-term operational note: do not ship quant kernel and batching heuristic in same deploy; require separate canary windows. Added a deploy-blocker tag in CI.
Sam Ortiz: I filed alert tuning ticket to detect sudden AZ divergence in decode failures (linked INFR-3204).
Lucas Patel: PR with version-header design: //git/redwood/runtime/pull/862. Feedback welcome.
Irene Novak: CI job added to run compatibility matrix; first run queued.
Nora (customer-ops): I'll draft the customer-facing incident summary postmortem and coordinate with legal if any SLAs triggered.
Priya Shah: Closing incident: system stable across AZs, monitoring for 3 hours. I'll update the postmortem doc: //docs/internal/postmortems/1715104444-kv-4bit-compat.md and link action items. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
IncidentBot: Incident marked RESOLVED by Priya Shah at 1715105150. Total incident window ~10 minutes for primary impact.
